creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-24 with a_2djt4hZrT. A claude -p that a pane's agent starts inherits $MUSTER_PANE. With Muster's messaging hooks installed, it runs msg read --if-unread as that pane, takes the pane's unread messages into its own context and marks them read, so the pane's agent never sees them. Reports from such a process are refused (attribution's walk finds the nested agent); msg requests are not, by decision when a_2djt4hZrT was fixed (10956827), because the pane's agent started it and a post from it plausibly speaks for that agent. A read is the case that hurts. Possibly: refuse or skip msg read --if-unread from a nested agent only, or have the hooks skip when the walk finds a nested agent.
title: A nested agent's messaging hooks read the pane's messages
